Tap to tap · hold, then move to drag · two fingers to scroll\nThree to five fingers: swipe up for recent apps, down for notifications, sideways for the previous app, pinch for all apps, spread for home

Tap to click · two-finger tap to right-click · hold, then move to drag · press firmly to force click\nTwo fingers: scroll, pinch to zoom · Three to five fingers: swipe up for Mission Control, down for App Exposé, left / right for spaces · four or five: pinch for Launchpad, spread for the desktop

AirBridge uses four and five fingers. If those are taken too, search Settings for “three-finger” and turn off the screenshot and split-screen gestures.
